Synopsis:
The privately owned ferry FILOJET capsized off Kyrenia, North Cyprus, shortly after departure toward Turkey's Tasucu port. Of 267 aboard, 241 were rescued, 8 confirmed dead, 18 missing. Rough sea conditions from prior storms are suspected as a contributing factor. The captain and seven crew were detained. Search and rescue operations ongoing with Turkish and North Cypriot coastguard assets deployed. The incident carries geopolitical undertones given North Cyprus's unrecognised status and reliance on Turkey.
